ResearchProjectDef.label: biological cultivation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to direct Wraith regenerative tissue into stable technological organs. Unlocks host-seed cultivation for the first Living Forge and basic grown settlement tissues.

ResearchProjectDef.label: living weapons
ResearchProjectDef.description: Shape cultivated Wraith tissue into purpose-grown capture weapons and lethal bio-organic arms.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced carapace cultivation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow reinforced living shells, command-grade carapaces and heavier Wraith combat organisms.

ResearchProjectDef.label: wraith feeding ecology
ResearchProjectDef.description: Organise Wraith feeding reserves and long-cycle dormancy into a stable life-force ecology. Unlocks player construction of feeding niches and hibernation pods without merging local colony feeding with strategic Hive hunger.

ResearchProjectDef.label: bioelectric organs
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow organs that consume cultured biomass to generate electricity and living cells that store it for ordinary colony power networks.
